scope: Exact source applicability comparison, not a new native authentication gate. Every unlisted source member and digest must remain identical.

nix/README.md.reason: Names the read-only ambit adapter. Home MCP does not import this document.

nix/pwa.nix.reason: New separately consumed static browser hosting module.

nix/tests/pwa-fixture.nix.reason: New browser-only fixture, not imported by Home MCP.

nix/tests/pwa-hosting.nix.reason: New browser-only hosting check, not imported by Home MCP.

nix/tests/pwa.nix.reason: New browser module check, not imported by Home MCP.

nix/types.nix.reason: Adds the read-only ambit adapter to the closed registry enum.

nix/validate.nix.reason: Requires an ambit instance to be read-only, audience ambit, and permission read.

profiles/README.md.reason: Documents the ambit-read grant carriage. Home MCP does not issue this profile.

profiles/src/atrium_profiles/definitions.reason: Adds the ambit-read profile id. Home MCP keeps its vendored copy unchanged.

profiles/src/atrium_profiles/models.py.reason: Accepts ambit-read grant claims. Home MCP does not validate this application profile.

profiles/src/atrium_profiles/v1/conforma.reason: Adds ambit-read permit and deny fixtures. Not imported by Home MCP.

profiles/src/atrium_profiles/v1/grant.sc.reason: Publishes ambit-read in the grant purpose enum.

profiles/src/atrium_profiles/v1/profiles.reason: Defines the ambit-read profile: audience ambit, canonical principal, fifteen minutes.

profiles/tests/conftest.py.reason: Builds synthetic ambit-read fixtures. Not imported by Home MCP.

profiles/tests/test_grants.py.reason: Checks ambit-read against the other grant profiles. Not imported by Home MCP.

resolver/MANIFESTS.md.reason: Discovery and opt-in Money module documentation, not executable consumer behavior.

resolver/README.md.reason: Browser discovery documentation, not executable consumer behavior.

resolver/src/atrium_resolver/app.py.reason: Non-minting browser discovery and opt-in module header negotiation, including the Family School today module; Home MCP does not run the resolver application.

resolver/src/atrium_resolver/credential_.reason: Names ambit-read as an issued client credential profile.

resolver/src/atrium_resolver/denies.py.reason: Recognizes an ambit-read association without treating its delivery hash as the jti.

resolver/src/atrium_resolver/issuance.py.reason: Issues ambit-read only for a read permission, an ambit audience, and no scopes.

resolver/src/atrium_resolver/manifests.p.reason: Describes an ambit connection as an ambit-read credential and carries its read permission.

resolver/src/atrium_resolver/policy.py.reason: Discovery accepts an optional wing filter. Home MCP's imported Decision and PolicyDenied definitions are unchanged and checked separately against the installed native package.

resolver/src/atrium_resolver/policy_sche.reason: Admits the ambit adapter only when it is read-only, audience ambit, and permission read.

resolver/tests/test_denies_http.py.reason: Covers ambit-read in the deny-association cases. Not imported by Home MCP.

resolver/tests/test_discovery.py.reason: Discovery and Money/Family School module negotiation tests, not imported by Home MCP.
